transcript: Really helpful if you have a really solid foundational asset like a video sales letter that then you can use in order to write your email. Take that video sales letter transcript. You can put it inside of chat, GPT or clause. And so now it has the context of what your pain points are, desires, et cetera, And then it's going to feed it through into this email sequence. So somebody can go through the same things that are getting you book calls in the VSL, but now you're going to start getting book calls from the emails. I use my video sales or transcript to write my ads with AI, to write my email campaigns, to write a bunch of stuff because I know that ultimately that has worked for me in the past.
